referendums.name: State of Wisconsin Partial Veto Referendum - QUESTION 1
referendums.ballotLanguage: QUESTION 1: “Partial veto. Shall section 10 (1) (c) of article V of the constitution be amended to prohibit the governor, in exercising his or her partial veto authority, from creating or increasing or authorizing the creation or increase of any tax or fee?”

referendums.name: State of Wisconsin Freedom to Gather in Places of Worship During an Emergency Referendum - QUESTION 2
referendums.ballotLanguage: QUESTION 2: "Freedom to gather in places of worship during an emergency. Shall section 18 of article I of the constitution, which deals with religious liberty, be amended to prohibit the state or a political subdivision of the state from ordering the closure of, or forbidding gatherings in, places of worship in response to a state of emergency, including a public health emergency?"

referendums.name: State of Wisconsin Governmental Entity Discrimination Prohibited Referendum - QUESTION 3
referendums.ballotLanguage: QUESTION 3: "Governmental entity discrimination prohibited. Shall section 27 of article I of the constitution be created to prohibit governmental entities in the state from discriminating against, or granting preferential treatment to, any individual or group on the basis of race, sex, color, ethnicity, or national origin in public employment, public education, public contracting, or public administration?"

referendums.name: Markesan School District Exceed Revenue Limit Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Question: Shall the Markesan District Schools be authorized to exceed state revenue limits on a non-recurring basis by $700,000.00 in each of four (4) consecutive years for the 2026-27, 2027-28, 2028-29, and 2029-30 school years to maintain school district programs and operations?

referendums.name: Princeton School District Exceed Revenue Limit Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Question Number I:  Shall the School District of Princeton, Green Lake and Marquette Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $575,000 for the 2027-2028 school year and by $1,200,000 per year for three years, beginning with the 2028-2029 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of costs associated with educational programming and staffing, ongoing maintenance and operations?

referendums.name: Princeton School District Improvement Project Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Question Number II:  Shall the School District of Princeton, Green Lake and Marquette Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to issue pursuant to Chapter 67 of the Wisconsin Statutes, general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $14,000,000 for the public purpose of paying the cost of a school facility improvement project consisting of:  district-wide safety and security improvements, including construction of secure entrances, building systems, infrastructure and capital maintenance improvements; renovations to instructional spaces; site and track improvements; and acquisition of furnishings, fixtures and equipment?
